title: Na Kare Narayan
desc: In the quaint and chaotic household of Amrut Patel, son of revered freedom fighter Nanakaka Shastri, things are never simple-but they're always hilarious! Amrut's three sons couldn't be more different: Arvind, a self-declared social reformer on a mission to save the country (whether the country wants it or not), Ashok, a melancholic soul sworn to celibacy after a failed heartbreak, and Amit, the youngest, brightest, and wittiest of the lot. Trouble knocks in the form of Mansukh, a greedy trustee of the Nanakaka Shastri Heritage Trust. With dreams of bulldozing every NGO linked to Nanakaka's name and replacing them with posh hotels and malls, Mansukh arrives with a double agenda-shut down the trust and marry off his daughter Priyanka to the clever Amit.
